correctness.rationale: For a strictly positive family sharing left Perron vector ell, ell-normalized projective products are uniformly contracting, giving a stationary normalized population profile continuous under arbitrary small entry perturbations. At zero perturbation, the one-step ell mass is the state-independent rho_k, so differentiating the log mass needs no derivative of the state. Conditional stationary first moments close exactly under the positive hd-by-hd block matrix M_{jk}=P_{jk}A_k/rho_k, yielding b_ij(U)=ell_i sum_{k in U} mu_{k,j}/rho_k. The iid factorization and its iff characterization follow by strict positivity. A noncommuting rational example was checked exactly. A standalone standard-library verifier executes finite-horizon derivative identities, exact rational block equations and exact Markov word enumeration; finite checks are supplementary and not treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Environment-specific sensitivities guide stage-specific intervention under fluctuating demography; their generic formulas require random-product or long-trajectory calculations. The result closes the relevant conditional demographic moments with a finite strictly positive Perron eigenproblem, valid at arbitrary environmental contrasts and without commutation, and gives a necessary-and-sufficient iid proportionality boundary. The exact rational example separates Markov correlation effects on intervention sensitivity from invariance of baseline growth. This is a mathematically motivated structural classification and constructive exact algorithm for a natural stochastic demographic family, not a routine numerical slice, mere normalization error, or restatement of the already known sum-elasticity identity.
